transportRole: internal Company Runtime transport; not the product's primary command port

desktopHost.bootstrap: BodyBrain starts the Guardian+BODY worker on the same deterministic localhost bootstrap port embedded in the production Chrome BODY Extension
desktopHost.guardianGate: desktop reports READY only after environment eligibility and Protection Supervisor initial checks pass; Task assignment remains fail-closed inside Company Runtime

identity.applicationModel: one Company Runtime application per Device by default
identity.legacyV5BrowserFallback: browser-<extensionInstanceId> when an older v5 adapter has no browserInstanceId

authentication.debugClient: 256-bit local token from daemon/profiles/.auth/client.token or BODY_DEBUG_TOKEN
authentication.extension: TOFU pairing bound to extensionInstanceId + runtimeExtensionId + browserInstanceId when supplied

controllerPolicy.brain: exclusive controller; physical execution requires an explicitly RUNNING taskId
controllerPolicy.debugClient: diagnostic/test only; mutating commands rejected while Brain is attached
controllerPolicy.bodyRuntime: continues recording and learning with or without Brain

brain.physicalActionRequirement: BODY_STEP requires contractVersion=1.0, a durable stepId, an explicitly RUNNING taskId, and exactly one Body step; TaskManager resolves Browser/Tab ownership and Browser eligibility before the at-most-one physical attempt

bodyContract.stepIdentity: taskId + stepId; requestId is transport-only and does not change Body step identity
bodyContract.deliverySemantics: durable at-most-once physical execution; duplicate completed steps replay the stored result; unresolved durable reservations return body_step_outcome_unknown and are never physically re-executed
bodyContract.eyes: BODY_OBSERVE requests a live Extension snapshot when available; cached facts remain explicitly age-tagged if live refresh fails
invariants: one taskId+stepId identity requests one Body step and permits at most one physical attempt
BODY returns facts and technical execution state, never task judgment
Brain alone decides semantic success/failure and next step
BODY learning changes HOW, never WHAT goal to pursue
Human and Agent provenance remain separate
Brain never accesses CDP/native-input/MotorLearning internals directly

taskWorkspace.invariant: one tab belongs to at most one active TaskWorkspace; one Browser may host many Tasks on different tabs

debugClient.purpose: manual smoke testing and diagnostics only

browserUi.executionBackend: persistent Windows SendInput worker plus bounded browser API fast path

hello.token: paired token or null on first pairing
